closureRule.what: Every ratified bar VALUE is unchanged, and `runsHoldingAllBars` keeps its original meaning. A breach gates closure UNLESS the scenario carries no SL-14 acceptance expectation, has no technically blocked Work, and its prompt is PROVEN byte-identical to the judge frozen before SL-14 — in which case it is recorded as the pre-existing SL-4-era Supervisor-quality carry-forward finding. Recorded as a human-governed contract correction, NOT as an accepted deviation.
